notes: A Convert button now sits at the top of the Measure half itself — the first thing on the screen, above the distance readout. The switch at the top of the tab is no longer the only way back, so opening Measure can never leave you with nowhere to go.

The Convert / Measure switch reserves its own height now (44 px, and it refuses to shrink). It is the one panel on that screen whose rounded corners clip it, and the Measure half was squeezing it to a sliver: that is the switch that kept disappearing.
Nothing else changed — the converter, GPS measuring, the AR range finder, the compass, permissions and updates are exactly as they were.
